caption: The drawing depicts a simple, outlined vase centered on a plain, off-white background. The vase is drawn with clean black lines, featuring gently curving sides, a slightly flared rim, and two small handles near the top. On the front of the vase, there is a decorative motif consisting of a single flower with multiple rounded petals and a short, curved stem ending in a leaf, all filled with a dark blue color. The flower design is centered on the upper middle portion of the vase, and the blue coloring is consistent, with shading used to indicate depth. The rest of the space around the vase is empty, with only the faint shading of the background visible.
title: Crock
